name: Omega 1 / Omega One data center (Le Port)
notes: First (and only verified) Tier-3-equivalent carrier-neutral DC on Reunion, in Le Port commune at the METISS cable arrival. Timeline: announced Nov 2022, TCO foundation ceremony 2023-05-04, inaugurated 13 Nov 2024. DCD/imazpress (B): 1 MW power, ~120 racks, EUR 10M investment. Operator site omegaone.re (A) claims ISO 27001 + HDS and 'equivalent Tier 3' (certification claims to be checked in registries). Existence/location A; capacity B-grade press value.

name: SFR Business Réunion NETCENTER (hébergement / colocation service)
notes: sfrbusiness.re official Reunion page (A/B) offers hosting services incl. Datacenter Virtuel (VDC) and VM migration; mainland NETCENTER offer covers 26 secure datacenters in France with ISO 27001-certified colocation. Service-level evidence only - no public named Reunion facility page verified this round; a directory (C) places an SFR Le Port address at 3 avenue Théodore Drouhet, Le Port, unconfirmed against first-party sources.

name: Zeop Entreprise data-center / hosting service
notes: Zeop enterprise page states all Zeop enterprise services are based in La Réunion, including data-center. Zeop belongs to the Océinde ecosystem that operates Omega 1; per methodology this is not double-counted as a separate facility - treated as a service lead referencing the Omega 1 infrastructure until a distinct named facility is proven.

name: REUNIX (Réunion Internet Exchange)
notes: Active IXP (the only live IXP on the island per ISOC Pulse, 2026-08), hosted at the University of Reunion, Saint-Denis, managed by RENATER; reduces Reunion-metropole link load. IXP/connectivity record, not a DC building.

name: SAFE cable landing station (Saint-Paul)
developer: SAFE consortium (AT&T, Angola Telecom, BICS, Camtel, China Telecom, Chunghwa Telecom)
notes: Connectivity record: SAFE (2002 RFS) lands at St. Paul, La Réunion; LION/LION2 and METISS also serve the island (METISS arrives at Le Port near Omega 1). Cable landings are connectivity context, not DC facilities. No hyperscaler public region exists in Reunion (AWS/Azure/GCP/OCI official region lists do not include RE - verified negative on run date; Azure France South is mainland France, not Reunion evidence).

name: Orange Réunion data centre services (lead)
notes: Operator lead only: reunion.orange.fr is live and Orange operates in Reunion (ARCEP-licensed operator), but no public Orange Reunion-specific DC facility page, ICPE/permit, or procurement evidence naming a data centre building was found on run date (French/English/Chinese sweeps). Per methodology remains a lead, not a facility record.
